about_the_game:
Welcome to the new "Sight", "Shiyuan: Tracing the Light" is an original stealth adventure, platform level game, and has a profound plot that explores the concept of "existence".

In the field of sight, you will transform into the existence of "what you want to be" and meet the gods that cannot be seen in reality, and they have already changed into your favorite form!

And the protagonist of the work, his wish is to no longer suffer from the suffering of "human suffering". He envied the free and unrestrained birds in his childhood, and now he has achieved his dream of becoming a Hillstar hummingbird!

But! He became the only example in the world of the Hillstar hummingbird population ..

Fortunately, at the moment of the extinction of the hummingbird tribe, in the flight of "freedom", he arrived at the Flower God Altar. The power of the Flower God is to "spread and breed". With her help, save the Housta hummingbird!

Game features:

--The thrilling experience in the forest breaks all previous game perceptions, and on the basis of platform jumping, you can even climb trees!

--Diverse skill experiences, characters can use the "mimicry" feature to transform into various butterflies, each with different skills!

--Defeat the strong with the weak, your protagonist is just a caterpillar (butterfly larva), but even a lion or tiger will definitely be defeated by you! (You can also choose to look for other ways)

--Become a god, you can contribute your soul to summon gods, transform into a human body for battle, and during the transformation period, you will have unparalleled abilities!

--Smooth and silky operation experience, beautiful artistic style, bringing you a unique experience!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium E2180 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD 580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In the land of dreams, searching for the meaning of existence, everything once dreamed of is just illusory, only in the "sight" can we trace back to the light of life.
